notes: Portable C++ and Java translation of the mapped native three-member Available/next-message timed-save case. The adapter supplies provider, FOM, endpoint, callback model, and logical-time implementation. Under HLA_EVOKED, two time-constrained members each request a strictly later grant 6 through TARA and NMRA after a timed save request at 5; each receives initiateFederateSave(5) before its own grant 6, while the non-time-constrained regulator waits for both members before its initiation. All three complete the save. Five direct requirement-section pairs cover clauses 4.19, 4.19.6, and 4.20. C++ primary and contract passed against an installed package under integer64 and float64 time using an adapter-supplied portable FOM. Java compiles against the official API only; provider runtime is unverified. The per-recipient callback-service sequence is an experimental public observation, not a universal cross-service ordering, immediate-callback, transport, interoperability, or conformance claim.
